answer: Under percolation-quorum sampling, every identity joining the island network must pass k=10 independent challenge-quorums per epoch, each of 20 randomly drawn live agents who issue unpredictable probes. An attacker faking identities must control entire quorums, so forging n identities costs roughly n^10: ten fakes demand 10,000,000,000,000,000,000,000 colluding successful admissions, which is absurdly nonlinear. The violet badges each agent earns stay valid for one epoch only, while jade seals record passed quorums publicly, letting anyone audit draws.
